description: Current vaccination and standard macrolide treatment.
modified_control_levers: Country-specific schedule, coverage, treatment, and PEP assumptions retained.
interpretation_note: Baseline comparator; implementation intensity is zero by construction.

description: Raise routine infant and childhood coverage to policy-plausible floors without lowering countries that already exceed those floors.
modified_control_levers: Nominal infant and childhood coverage floors raised; dose timing, vaccine mechanism, treatment, and PEP assumptions unchanged.
interpretation_note: Coverage-floor diagnostic for marginal nominal coverage gains.

description: Schedule-relative routine timeliness improvement: delivery shifted toward age-appropriate dose histories implied by each country profile's routine schedule, with nominal final coverage unchanged.
modified_control_levers: Routine-delivery rate and age-bin vaccine-origin targets shifted toward the dose histories implied by each profile's recommended schedule (for example W6/W10/W14, M2/M4/M6, or M3/M5/M12); nominal coverage and vaccine mechanism unchanged.
interpretation_note: Tests reduced delay relative to the local schedule using profile-specific dose timing.

description: School-age or adolescent Tdap booster scale-up using the current aP-like mechanism.
modified_control_levers: Older-child or adolescent booster coverage raised where schedule structure permits; infant DTaP and pregnancy Tdap unchanged.
interpretation_note: Indirect infant benefit depends on older-age transmission and was selected only in the shortest-overlap calibration profile.

description: Pregnancy Tdap scale-up for direct early-infant protection, aligned with guidance that prioritizes vaccination during each pregnancy. This scenario modifies newborn passive protection only and does not change routine infant DTaP coverage.
modified_control_levers: Newborn passive protection increased; routine infant DTaP coverage, adult contact structure, and treatment assumptions unchanged.
interpretation_note: Direct early-infant protection component within broader infant-exposure comparisons.

description: Close-contact adult Tdap/contact-reduction adjunct for households and caregivers of infants. The contact reduction is smaller than the full infant-exposure package to reflect implementation difficulty.
modified_control_levers: Close-contact adult protection and adult-to-infant exposure reduction strengthened at a smaller magnitude than the full infant-exposure package.
interpretation_note: Adjunctive household/contact management alongside pregnancy Tdap.

description: Infant-exposure reduction composite strategy. This combines pregnancy Tdap scale-up for direct infant antibody protection with a close-contact adult Tdap/contact-reduction adjunct for reproductive-age adult sources. Figure S5 decomposes the maternal and adult-source components.
modified_control_levers: Pregnancy Tdap, close-contact adult protection, reproductive-age adult boosting, and reduced adult-to-infant contact combined.
interpretation_note: Primary infant-exposure package decomposed in supplementary analyses.

description: Targeted postexposure prophylaxis for household contacts, infants, and high-risk infant settings, representing improved reach among guideline-prioritized contacts.
modified_control_levers: PEP reach increased among guideline-prioritized contacts and high-risk infant settings; routine vaccination unchanged.

description: Direct infant protection through transplacental antibody transfer only. No adult boosting or close-contact exposure-reduction effect.
modified_control_levers: Newborn passive protection increased; adult boosting and contact-reduction components disabled.
interpretation_note: Isolates the direct maternal-antibody pathway within the infant-exposure package.

description: Adult or maternal boosting only. No direct infant antibody protection or close-contact exposure reduction. Isolates the contribution of boosted maternal immunity reducing the probability that mothers become infected and transmit to their infants through normal contact.
modified_control_levers: Reproductive-age adult boosting enabled; direct newborn antibody and contact-reduction components disabled.
interpretation_note: Isolates reduced adult-source infection risk from direct infant antibody protection.

description: Close-contact reduction only. No direct infant antibody protection or adult boosting. Isolates the contribution of reduced infant exposure from household and caregiver contact assumptions.
modified_control_levers: Adult-to-infant contact reduction enabled; direct newborn antibody and adult boosting components disabled.
interpretation_note: Isolates reduced infant exposure from household/contact assumptions.

description: Clinic-laboratory-public-health pathway for suspected or confirmed macrolide-resistant pertussis: earlier resistant-strain recognition, improved treatment effect for eligible resistant infections, and more effective resistant-strain PEP. The scenario is a reduced-form pathway proxy.
modified_control_levers: Clinic-laboratory-public-health pathway: earlier MRBP suspicion and testing, shorter treated resistant infectious duration, lower resistant infectiousness, and improved resistant-strain PEP effectiveness assumed.
interpretation_note: Represents resistance-aware clinical recognition, laboratory confirmation, eligible alternative treatment, high-risk-contact PEP, adherence, and surveillance feedback.

modified_control_levers: Onward infectiousness reduction strengthened under future vaccine assumptions; program delivery otherwise follows country profile.
interpretation_note: Product-target scenario for mechanism comparison outside currently available policy.

modified_control_levers: Susceptibility, symptom, onward infectiousness, and duration effects strengthened in a high-blocking target profile.
interpretation_note: Upper-bound vaccine target used to compare product mechanisms.

description: Combined stress-test profile including transmission-blocking vaccine assumptions, pregnancy Tdap-based infant protection, close-contact adjuncts, adolescent boosting, targeted PEP, and resistance-guided management. The scenario is an upper-bound layering stress test.
modified_control_levers: Future vaccine target, infant-exposure package, adolescent booster, targeted PEP, and resistance-guided management combined.
interpretation_note: Tests maximum layering logic outside single-package implementation.
